code.text: COAG

text.div:
Annotation

Conclusion and Recommendations based on this report and previous findings known to us:
The patient shows hypoxemia with low arterial oxygen saturation and partial pressure, mild normocytic anemia, leukopenia with neutropenia, thrombocytopenia, and elevated inflammatory markers (CRP, ferritin). There is mild metabolic acidosis (low pH), slightly elevated urea, and increased INR. These findings suggest possible acute or chronic respiratory compromise, inflammation or infection, and a risk of bleeding. Clinical correlation and further evaluation are recommended.
